# Planner handoff probe

Use only a disposable OpenCode 2.2.7 project configured with `smoke/model-one#high` at the loopback mock provider in this directory. The fixture bypasses the production request guard and submits one synthetic local prompt; never point it at a paid provider. It checks the host response handoff into a saved clarification, not repository research, accounting, crash recovery, or a complete planner workflow.
